reconstructed_captions.15: He steps onto a rock in the middle of the stream to begin his crossing.
reconstructed_captions.16: He carefully balances as he moves from one rock to another.
reconstructed_captions.17: He continues to navigate the rocky stream bed.
reconstructed_captions.18: The man keeps his focus on his footing while crossing the stream.
reconstructed_captions.19: He takes another deliberate step onto a large, flat rock.
reconstructed_captions.20: He is now more than halfway across the stream.
reconstructed_captions.21: He approaches the far bank of the stream, looking for a spot to step.
reconstructed_captions.22: He takes his final step from a rock onto the leafy bank.
reconstructed_captions.23: Having crossed the stream, he stands on the bank and looks ahead.
